jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Data Center Deployment & Operations
jobs.description:
TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER, DATA CENTER DEPLOYMENT & OPERATIONS




ABOUT PARASAIL

Parasail builds inference infrastructure for open-weight AI models. Behind one API, we bring together distributed GPU capacity and optimize how workloads run across it, helping customers access reliable, high-performance inference without managing the underlying infrastructure.

We’re building the team that deploys and operates the hardware behind that platform.


ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll own the delivery and ongoing operation of Parasail’s GPU infrastructure within partner data centers—from white space fit-out and site readiness through equipment installation, validation, and production launch.

Initially, data center partners, hardware vendors, installation contractors, and remote-hands providers will perform much of the physical work. You’ll own those operational relationships and be accountable for execution: setting expectations, coordinating dependencies, verifying quality, and resolving issues.

You’ll work closely with engineering and supply chain to align technical requirements, equipment availability, and site readiness. After launch, you’ll oversee the partners and processes that keep the infrastructure running reliably. As Parasail grows, you’ll help determine which capabilities to bring in-house and build the team to support deployments and operations across locations.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own partner and vendor execution. Manage operational relationships with data center providers, installation contractors, and remote-hands teams. Define scopes of work, responsibilities, service expectations, and escalation paths.

 - Lead white space fit-out and deployment. Coordinate rack layouts, power and cooling readiness, structured cabling, equipment installation, and network connectivity with site partners and engineering.

 - Run the integrated delivery plan. Connect hardware delivery, site preparation, installation, testing, and production readiness into one schedule. Track dependencies, hold owners accountable, and resolve blockers.

 - Translate requirements into executable work. Ensure engineering specifications become clear vendor deliverables. Review plans with technical owners and manage changes before they create rework or delays.

 - Drive validation and acceptance. Establish completion criteria with engineering, coordinate hardware checks and burn-in, and verify installation quality and documentation before accepting work.

 - Own ongoing physical infrastructure operations. Coordinate maintenance, hardware replacements, site access, and changes with vendors and engineering. Establish support coverage and procedures that protect service availability.

 - Lead operational escalations. Bring together vendors, site teams, and engineers to resolve hardware and site issues. Track restoration, communicate impact, and ensure corrective actions are completed.

 - Maintain accurate operational records. Ensure rack layouts, asset locations, configurations, and service histories stay current. Partner with Supply Chain on receiving discrepancies, spares, and returns.

 - Manage delivery costs and risks. Track vendor work against agreed scope and budget, review change requests, and communicate schedule or service risks with clear recovery options.

 - Build the function. Develop repeatable deployment and operating practices. Identify staffing needs, help hire and develop the internal team, and define how employees and external partners work together as Parasail scales.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Experience delivering and supporting physical infrastructure in data center environments, including white space fit-out, hardware deployment, or technical operations.

 - Direct responsibility for managing vendors or service providers and holding them accountable for schedule, quality, and service performance.

 - Experience taking deployments from requirements and planning through installation, validation, and operational handoff.

 - Working technical knowledge of server hardware, rack infrastructure, cabling, networking, and power and cooling requirements sufficient to evaluate plans and assess completed work.

 - Strong program management skills, including coordinating multiple workstreams, managing dependencies, and driving issues to closure.

 - Experience coordinating maintenance or incident response in production environments.

 - The ability to build practical processes where ownership and systems are still developing.

 - Clear communication with technical teams, external partners, and leadership, especially when a deployment or service commitment is at risk.

 - Willingness to travel for site assessments, deployments, partner reviews, and operational needs.


HELPFUL EXPERIENCE

 - GPU infrastructure, high-density racks, liquid cooling, or high-speed network fabrics.

 - Managing colocation providers, installation contractors, or remote-hands services across multiple sites.

 - Earlier hands-on experience installing, troubleshooting, or maintaining data center equipment.

 - Defining vendor scopes of work, acceptance criteria, and service-level expectations.

 - Hiring, mentoring, or leading data center technicians or infrastructure operations teams.

 - Building an internal operations capability alongside external service providers.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

GPU capacity enters production on a dependable schedule, with installation quality and operational readiness verified. Partners understand their responsibilities and meet their commitments. Hardware issues are resolved promptly, records remain accurate, and each deployment strengthens the processes and team supporting the next.

jobs.title: Lead Technical Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
LEAD TECHNICAL PRODUCT MARKETING MANAGER




ABOUT PARASAIL

Parasail is building the inference cloud for AI-native companies. We help teams deploy and scale AI models with the performance, reliability, and flexibility their applications need, without managing the underlying GPU infrastructure.

We’re building a marketing team that can translate deep technical capabilities into a clear story, strong customer relationships, and repeatable growth.


THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Technical Product Marketing Manager who can understand how customers build with AI, explain where Parasail fits, and bring that story to market.

You’ll work closely with our marketing lead, sales, product, and engineering teams to sharpen our positioning, build customer advocacy, develop ecosystem partnerships, and grow our presence at technical events. You should be equally comfortable discussing inference tradeoffs with an engineer, helping a customer develop a compelling conference presentation, and turning customer insights into messaging that helps sales win.

Your initial focus will be expanding our technical event program and building the customer stories, partner relationships, and product marketing foundation that make those efforts effective. This is a hands-on role with room to shape both the strategy and how we execute as the company grows.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

Build a technical event program that drives customer relationships and pipeline.

 - Develop an event strategy spanning conferences, meetups, hackathons, technical panels, and customer dinners, initially focused on the Bay Area and expanding our New York presence.

 - Represent Parasail in conversations with developers, AI founders, and technical buyers. Explain our platform, understand their workloads, and identify opportunities for deeper engagement.

 - Recruit customer and partner speakers, develop session narratives, and help presenters deliver compelling talks and demonstrations.

 - Equip colleagues with the messaging, demos, and customer examples they need to represent Parasail effectively.

 - Partner with sales on audience targeting and follow-up, and turn event conversations and presentations into content that extends their reach.

 - Coordinate with event operations support as available, while owning the technical program, audience experience, and business outcomes.

Turn customer success into a repeatable marketing program.

 - Build relationships with customers who can become speakers, references, design partners, and advocates.

 - Create case studies, technical customer stories, interviews, and presentations that explain the workload, deployment decisions, and measurable results.

 - Develop customer advisory and structured beta programs with product and customer-facing teams.

 - Bring customer feedback into product planning, messaging, and launch decisions.

Develop partnerships across the AI ecosystem.

 - Build relationships with model providers, developer platforms, integration partners, and complementary infrastructure companies.

 - Identify opportunities for joint content, events, launches, and technical education.

 - Work with product and sales to evaluate integration and channel opportunities based on customer demand and commercial potential.

 - Turn promising relationships into concrete programs with clear owners and outcomes.

Build the product marketing foundation for growth.

 - Refine our ideal customer profiles and priority use cases through customer interviews, sales feedback, and market research.

 - Develop positioning and messaging that explain who Parasail serves, the problems we solve, and why customers choose us.

 - Create technical content and sales materials, including presentations, solution briefs, competitive comparisons, and demo narratives.

 - Lead go-to-market planning for new products and capabilities, coordinating the audience, story, enablement, and launch content.

 - Measure what works through qualified engagement, pipeline contribution, customer participation, and adoption, and use those findings to focus our efforts.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Experience in technical product marketing, solutions or sales engineering, developer relations, or a related customer-facing role, with demonstrated ability to turn technical knowledge into effective marketing.

 - Fluency in AI infrastructure and the model lifecycle, from training and fine-tuning through inference and production serving. You can discuss latency, throughput, reliability, and cost with technical buyers.

 - Strong writing and storytelling skills. You can turn a complex architecture or customer deployment into a clear explanation of its value.

 - Experience developing technical events, conference sessions, customer presentations, or community programs, including recruiting and supporting speakers.

 - An ability to earn trust with customers and partners and turn those relationships into useful, sustained collaboration.

 - Comfort moving between strategy and execution: interviewing a customer, drafting a launch narrative, presenting at an event, and following through on the details.

 - Strong judgment about priorities and the ability to build practical, repeatable programs in a small team.

 - Availability to collaborate in person in the Bay Area and travel for selected events and customer engagements.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience combining sales engineering with technical marketing.

 - Familiarity with distributed computing, open-source AI tooling, or model-serving platforms.

 - Experience building customer advisory boards, beta programs, or customer advocacy programs.

 - Experience developing joint marketing programs with technology and integration partners.

 - Hands-on ability to build or adapt technical demos and work with APIs.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Parasail has a consistent technical event presence, with clear audiences, strong content, and dependable sales follow-up.

 - Customers regularly participate in case studies, talks, references, and product feedback programs.

 - Ecosystem partnerships produce joint programs and qualified commercial opportunities.

 - Sales and marketing share a clear view of our priority customers, use cases, and differentiation.

 - Product launches reach the right audiences with credible technical content and a clear reason to adopt.


WHY JOIN PARASAIL

You’ll help shape how an AI infrastructure company tells its story, connects with developers, and builds its market. You’ll work directly with customers solving demanding inference problems and with the engineers building the platform behind them.

This is an opportunity to establish programs from the beginning, own visible outcomes, and build a product marketing function alongside a growing company.
